A political letter 2019 mentions Maya. A copy of the will of the 2024 family names Priya as the beneficiary of the estate. Those statements may refer to different assets.

runs.translation:
La factura muestra $1,240. Un comprobante más tarde registra un pago $400, pero no lo conecta explícitamente con esa factura.

La factura está fechada September 10. El comprobante registra un pago $400 el día September 14.

¿Este pago se aplicó a esta factura? ¿Cuánto queda por pagar?

Solicita un balance actualizado detallado y pregúntale dónde se aplicó el pago.
runs.back_translation:
The invoice shows $1,240. A later receipt records a payment $400, but does not explicitly link it to that invoice.

The invoice is dated September 10. The receipt records a payment $400 on day September 14.

Was this payment applied to this invoice? How much remains to be paid?

Request a detailed updated balance and ask where the payment was applied.
